mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLANT_STORY (TITLE, CONTENT, USER_EMAIL) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{userEmail});
mapper.select:
SELECT BOARD_NUM, USER_EMAIL, ( SELECT USER_NAME FROM user WHERE USER_EMAIL = PS.USER_EMAIL ) AS USER_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, READ_CNT,
IFNULL(( SELECT 'Y' FROM LIKE_PLANT WHERE USER_EMAIL = IFNULL(#{userEmail}, '') AND BOARD_NUM = PS.BOARD_NUM ), 'N') AS IS_LIKE,
( SELECT COUNT(LIKE_NUM) FROM LIKE_PLANT WHERE BOARD_NUM = PS.BOARD_NUM ) AS LIKE_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(COMMENT_ID) FROM PLANT_REPLY WHERE BOARD_NUM = PS.BOARD_NUM ) AS REPLY_CNT,
IFNULL(( SELECT 'Y' FROM follow WHERE FROM_USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail} AND TO_USER_EMAIL = PS.USER_EMAIL ), 'N') AS IS_FOLLOW
FROM plant_story PS ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC;
SELECT USER_EMAIL FROM PLANT_STORY WHERE BOARD_NUM = #{boardNum}
SELECT BOARD_NUM, USER_EMAIL, TITLE,REG_DATE, IS_LIKE,LIKE_CNT,REPLY_CNT,IS_FOLLOW FROM PLANT_STORY

SELECT PS.BOARD_NUM, PS.TITLE, PS.CONTENT, PS.READ_CNT, PS.REG_DATE, PS.USER_EMAIL, COUNT(LP.LIKE_NUM) AS LIKE_CNT FROM PLANT_STORY PS INNER JOIN LIKE_PLANT LP ON PS.BOARD_NUM = LP.BOARD_NUM GROUP BY PS.BOARD_NUM ORDER BY LIKE_CNT DESC LIMIT 10
